instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_035_flat_pattern_bracket.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file, a 2 mm thick U-shaped sheet metal bracket that is 60 mm long in Y, has a 40 mm bottom web in X, and has two 35 mm high side flanges. Generate a flat pattern using bend inside radius 2 mm and K-factor 0.5. The unfolded 2 mm thick flat sheet should be about 119.42 mm long by 60 mm wide. Export the flat sheet as C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_035_flat_pattern_out.step and also export the original bent part as C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_035_bent_original.step. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut).
